script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "Heart's Ambition"

INT. NEW YORK CITY APARTMENT - NIGHT

(A cozy living room. The dimly lit room is filled with books, art, and the warm glow of a fireplace. JASPER, a dashing 30-something man, stands over the fireplace, a glass of red wine in his hand.)

JASPER
(sighs)
Another long day at the office...

(Suddenly, the doorbell rings. Jasper puts down his glass and heads to the door. He opens it to reveal ISABELLA, a stunning woman in her early 30s, carrying a tray of desserts.)

ISABELLA
(smiling)
I thought you could use something sweet after a long day.

JASPER
(chuckles)
You always know how to brighten my day, Isabella.

(Isabella hands Jasper a plate of desserts and they sit down by the fireplace. They share a moment, their eyes locked, before Jasper speaks.)

JASPER
You know, I've always admired your ambition, Isabella. Your drive to succeed in the art world is inspiring.

ISABELLA
(blushing)
Thank you, Jasper. I've always admired your ambition, too. Your dedication to your law practice is impressive.

(They share a meaningful look, both knowing that their ambitions have often kept them apart. But for now, they are content to enjoy each other's company.)

---

EXT. NEW YORK CITY PARK - DAY

(Jasper and Isabella sit on a bench, surrounded by the beautiful colors of fall. They talk about their goals and dreams, their hands intertwined. But as they speak, it's clear that their ambitions may not be aligned.)

ISABELLA
I know we both have a lot going on in our lives, but I can't help but feel like we're meant to be together.

JASPER
(sighs)
I wish it were that simple, Isabella. My law practice requires all of my time and energy. And I know that your art career is just starting to take off. We can't let our ambitions come between us.

ISABELLA
(tears in her eyes)
Then what should we do?

JASPER
(looking deep into her eyes)
We'll figure it out, together. Our ambitions don't have to be a barrier. They can be a source of strength and support for each other.

---

INT. ISABELLA'S ART STUDIO - NIGHT

(Isabella works late into the night, painting a beautiful landscape. Jasper enters, carrying a tray of coffee and pastries. They sit down and talk, discussing their plans for the future. Their ambitions may not always align, but they are committed to finding a way to make their relationship work.)

---

EXT. NEW YORK CITY STREETS - DAY

(Jasper and Isabella walk hand in hand through the bustling streets of New York City. They may have their own goals and dreams, but they know that they'll face them together, with love and support.)

---

INT. ISABELLA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

(Jasper surprises Isabella with a solo exhibition of her art at a prestigious gallery. They celebrate with friends and family, and Jasper makes a heartfelt speech about Isabella's talent and ambition.)

---

EXT. NEW YORK CITY COURTHOUSE - DAY

(Jasper argues a high-stakes case in court. Isabella sits in the audience, proud of him and his accomplishments. After the case is won, they celebrate together.)

---

INT. NEW YORK CITY APARTMENT - NIGHT

(Jasper and Isabella sit by the fireplace, talking about their future plans and dreams. They may have their own ambitions, but they know that they'll always be there for each other, no matter what.)

---

EXT. NEW YORK CITY PARK - DAY

(Jasper and Isabella sit on the same bench, watching the sunset. They talk about their lives, their dreams, and their love. Their ambitions may have brought them challenges, but they know that they'll face them together, with love and support.)

---

INT. ISABELLA'S ART GALLERY - NIGHT

(Isabella's art is displayed in a beautiful exhibit, and she receives critical acclaim and accolades. Jasper stands by her side, proud of her and her achievements. They share a kiss, knowing that their love and ambition will always be intertwined.)

---

INT. NEW YORK CITY APARTMENT - NIGHT

(Jasper and Isabella sit on the couch, snuggled up together, looking at their future plans and dreams. Their ambitions may have brought them challenges, but they know that they'll always be there for each other, no matter what.)

---

END OF SCREENPLAY.
